design_note: GRAVE V8 INTEGRATED skeleton-only. V7 redundant horizontal braces and separate mounts removed; paired single-piece hollow cranio-mandibular castings with variable depth and integral armor interface zones, sculpted neck coupling, single Y-shaped occipital anchor, compact crown coupler, single optical saddle, anterior-relocated controller and short external bearing axles. Preserve mono lens, neck pivot, common camera. Distinguish static intentional mount contacts from moving interfaces; actual mesh contact and strength unverified, no armor yet. V7 remains available. Based on V7 review and 2026-11-27-19/12-modeling.
